sourceAccessAndReadingLimits: All eleven selected Europe PMC fullTextXML attempts failed with HTTP 500 and remain recorded. Four bodies were assessed through legal raw PMC HTML or a verified held XML capture; no challenge was bypassed.

Hudecek targeted paragraphs distinguish particular spacer/Fc constructs, culture readouts and NSG mouse experiments from unknown patient effects. The held XML matches a prior committed capture receipt.
Roybal’s expression-decay assay and bilateral tumour-growth experiment do not supply a universal receptor half-life, clinical safety guarantee or direct measurement of cell migration.
Zah’s addendum concerns donor preparations and xenografts; its post-thaw observation does not validate a universal clinical viability cutoff.
Tang’s 10 Gy and short detection window apply to three recipients of an irradiated CD33 CAR NK-92 preparation. Proposed improvements in its Discussion are not established clinical results.

The cord-blood CAR-NK trial, inducible-IL-12 TIL trial and prostate receptor-variant study concern different complete constructs and populations. Component contributions and class-wide safety/persistence are not isolated.
Most papers remain abstract-only. FDA January 2024 guidance pages and selected NCI blocks were read at targeted depth, with no whole-document or present approval-inventory certification.
The inherited tebentafusp indication/mechanism blocks match their prior raw SPL receipt. The initially misrouted HTML shell is not label evidence and nothing was freshly re-read from that shell.
